title: derris philippinensis
intro: Derris philippinensis, commonly known as Kanemite or Philippine Derris, is a plant species that belongs to the Leguminosae family. It is native to the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia, and is known for its various medicinal properties. The health benefits of Derris philippinensis include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Derris philippinensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
